findings.claim: Autoliv Wuhu（安徽）新氣囊廠 2026-08-10 動工，預計 2027 年投產，採自動化產線。
findings.source: GDELT Cloud event: Autoliv breaks ground on new Wuhu airbag plant
findings.excerpt: Autoliv Wuhu Safety Systems broke ground on a new airbag plant in Jiujiang District, Wuhu City, Anhui Province. The facility will feature automated assembly lines and is expected to begin production in 2027.

findings.claim: GlobalData 2026 年 6 月被動安全報告：全球 OE 前氣囊 2026 年約 1.677 億顆，年複合成長約 1.3%，2033 年 1.837 億顆。
findings.source: GlobalData Sector Innovation Report: Passive Safety (ResearchAndMarkets)
findings.excerpt: The Global Component volume of OE front airbags is estimated at 167.7 million units in 2026 and is expected to post a CAGR of 1.3% over the forecast period. The market is expected to reach 183.7 million units by 2033.

findings.claim: Autoliv 2026 Q2 10-Q：淨資本支出年減 $20 million、占營收 3.4%，主因較少 footprint optimization 與產能擴張。
findings.excerpt: The level of capital expenditure, net, in relation to sales declined to 3.4% versus 4.2% a year earlier. The lower level of capital expenditure, net is mainly related to the lower activity level of footprint optimization and less capacity expansion.

findings.claim: Autoliv 8-K：逐步結束土耳其製造（方向盤、氣囊、安全帶），生產移至其他 EMEA 廠，稅前費用約 $142 million。
findings.excerpt: Autoliv to Discontinue Manufacturing Operations in Türkiye (Stockholm, Sweden, May 8, 2026) – Autoliv, Inc. (NYSE: ALV and SSE: ALIVsdb), the worldwide leader in automotive safety systems, continues its strategy to align production capacity with future EMEA market requirements. As part of this strategy, Autoliv will gradually discontinue its manufacturing operations in Türkiye.

findings.claim: Joyson Safety Systems 匈牙利 Miskolc 工廠擴建，總投資 HUF 16 billion（補助 4.9 billion），稱將成全球最大被動安全工廠。

cyclical_supply_discipline_capacity.note: 同業（ZF、Hyundai Mobis、Toyoda Gosei）產能紀律與資本支出計畫查無來源；Joyson 匈牙利 Miskolc 擴建（HUF 16 billion）有網址但無發布日。Autoliv 自身 2026 Q2 淨資本支出 3.4% 營收，低於去年同期，原因含較少產能擴張（10-Q 摘要轉述，未取得原文）。 線索 3 條，程式核實 2 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
